data.name: Alhusayn
data.long_meaning: Alhusayn is a name of Arabic origin, mentioned in Islamic history and sources. It is derived from 'Ahl al-Bayt', meaning 'People of the House' or 'Master of the Sacred House'. This name is deeply rooted in the history of Islam, as it refers to the grandson of Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) and the son of Imam Ali (as).

in_arabic.name: الحسين
in_arabic.meaning: عبد الله بن علي بن أبي طالب، أبو عبد الله الحسن بن علي الحسين
in_arabic.long_meaning: الْحُسَيْنُ بنُ عَلِيٍّ بنِ أَبِي طَالِبٍ، أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَهِ، الْحُسَيْنُ مُحَمَدٌ رَسُولُ اللَهِ، وَلَدَهُ أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَهِ الْحَسَنُ، وَالحُسَيْنُ وَصِيٌّ لَهُ عَلَيْهِ السَلَامُ، وَالسِيَماَةُ الَّتِي جَمَعَ اللَهُ عَلَيْهِ مِنَ الَمَناقِبِ وَالأَخلاقِ وَالأَعَجَابَاتِ، وَهِيَ أَنَهُ مِنَ الْمُقَرَّبِينَ، وَأَنَ لَهُ مِنَ الرِضَا عِنْدَ اللَهِ، وَأَنَهُ مِنَ النَبِيِّينَ، وَأَنَ هُوَ الَّذِي رَمَاهُ الظَلامَةُ بِالنُجاحَةِ، وَأَنَ هُوَ الَّذِي رَأَاهُ اللَهُ عَلَيْهِ السَلَامُ فَكَشَفَ عَنْهُ الظُلمَةَ، وَأَنَ هُوَ الَّذِي اِنتَضَضَ عَلى مَقَامِهِ مِنَ الاِنتِدابِ، وَأَنَ هُوَ الَّذِي جَزَاهُ اللَهُ عَلَيْهِ السَلَامُ بِالرِضَا وَالنُجاحِ، وَأَنَ هُوَ الَّذِي جَمَعَ اللَهُ عَلَيْهِ مِنَ الشُجَعَةِ وَالخَطبَةِ، وَأَنَ هُوَ الَّذِي جَعَلَ اللَهُ عَلَيْهِ السَلَامُ رَزِيَةً وَمَقامًا مُذَكَّرً

in_urdu.name: الحسین
in_urdu.meaning: عبد اللہ بن علی بن ابی طالب، ابو عبد اللہ حسین بن علی

in_english.name: Alhusayn
in_english.meaning: Abdullah bin Ali bin Abi Talib, Abu Abdullah Alhussayn bin Ali, grandson of the Prophet Muhammad, and the second son of Ali
in_english.long_meaning: Alhussayn bin Ali bin Abi Talib, Abu Abdullah, was the grandson of the Prophet Muhammad and the second son of Ali. His name is derived from the Arabic root "Hussayn", which means "Protector" or "Guardian". In Islamic tradition, Alhussayn is considered a martyr and a symbol of resistance against oppression. He is also known for his courage and bravery in the face of adversity. Alhussayn's life and legacy have been celebrated in poetry, art, and literature throughout history. He is considered one of the most important figures in Islamic history and a central figure in the Shia Islamic tradition. Alhussayn's story has been retold and reinterpreted in various forms of art and literature, highlighting his bravery, selflessness, and devotion to his faith. His legacy continues to inspire people around the world, especially in the Middle East and South Asia. Alhussayn's name has become synonymous with courage, resilience, and determination in the face of adversity. He is a powerful symbol of the human spirit and a reminder of the importance of standing up for what is right, even in the face of overwhelming odds. Alhussayn's story has been immortalized in the hearts and minds of people around the world, and his legacy continues to inspire new generations of Muslims and non-Muslims alike.
